authorization: Owner told the orchestrator on 2026-11-22 to use the remaining PixelLab credits today; same-day exception to the retirement rule.
method: create_character_pro_flash (32x32 native, low top-down, custom body template because a crab fits no skeleton, 8 views, 40-colour palette, seed 51) then animate_character v3 per direction (frames come back on 40-44 px canvases, centred on 32x32 without scaling). v3 only makes even frame counts, so idle keeps frames 0-2 of 4 and telegraph keeps frames 1-3 of 4; dropped frames are not shipped. All four facings are separate generations; nothing is mirrored.
prompt: Kiln crab, a small chibi crab with a very wide low round shell shaped like a brick kiln dome with a glowing orange vent slit on top, dark charcoal-grey and rust-brown shell, two large heavy pincer claws held forward, six short stubby legs, two small eyes on short stalks glowing orange. Front-facing 3/4 top-down, chunky pixel art, 1px dark outline, light from top-left.
